confidence_notes: Recent city-specific aggregate prices support the meal, cappuccino, and draft-beer anchors. Cocktail and restaurant wine prices are bounded estimates based on their typical premium over local beer; hostel and hotel prices are holistic estimates and have the widest uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Puerto Princesa's city-specific price index; accommodation uses broader lower-cost Philippine tourism-hub levels with a Palawan visitor-demand premium.
